structuredContent.formatGuide: Pass the id as `format` (or in shop's `creatives`). Omitting it makes a single-page meme. iMessage / text-message thread → "hybrid"; carousel / slideshow / multi-slide → "carousel"; hot take / opinion → "hottake"; confession → "confession"; single meme / static image → "image".
